text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having joined the baseball team as manager at Vivlos's invitation,
the day of the main event had finally arrived—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today was the recording for the variety TV show,
where celebrities played baseball against horse girls.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Everyone, let's keep it tight♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if it was just a show game, we wanted to win.
We began the game full of fighting spirit, but—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
With bases loaded, that should have been an absolute out.
Failing to catch it in that situation... is pathetic of me.
I'm so sorry.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
With a hit like that, it couldn't be helped even if you missed.
We really need to turn this around, but...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Uu... Onee-chan...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
(There's zero excitement in this.
If things go on like this—)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...We can't let it end like this!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: H-Huh?! Limit our swings... to a specific pitch...?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ignore breaking balls and go strictly for fastballs!
We'll smack it *crack* and win *kaboom*♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Let's make a sparkling comeback together!
Doesn't that sound thrilling? Right?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Limiting our pitch selection would reduce batting chances.
It could back us into an even tighter corner, but—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! If we're aiming, we aim for number one.
Playing normally won't turn this around anyway.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If Vivlos-chan says so, I'm sure it'll be fine.
That's how it's always been, desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Everyone nodded resolutely.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone!
Time for a super sparkly grand comeback, here we gooo!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now, here comes the horse girls' turn at bat!
However, they aren't swinging at all. Rather, this is—

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: They're narrowing down which pitch types to swing at, huh! It'd be super exciting if they could turn things around here, though!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Bases loaded, bases loaaaded!
And next up is my turn to bat!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Trainer-san, are you nervous?
Your face looks so scary!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, don't worry, everything's gonna be fiiine♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: —Because I am definitely hitting it out of the park.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos stepped up to the batter's box.
Two outs, but with the bases loaded.
Under this kind of pressure, anyone would be sweating, yet—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She was smiling.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*CRACK—!!*)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
I-It's outta here—!
Vivlos hits a grand slam!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Just as promised! V for victory♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Whatever I want, I make sure to get it!
Bags, cosmetics—and victory too, of course♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Whatever I want, I make sure to get it!
Bags, cosmetics—and victory too, of course♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Right, right♪
Praise me more! Spoil me rotten, okay??

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: If you do that, I'll be able to work eveeenn harder♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos...
Once again, doing what I couldn't...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I must work hard too...
So I can continue being a proper role model for my little sister.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Vivlos...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Vivlos's stellar performance, the momentum shifted our way.
In the end, we pulled off a brilliant comeback victory.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Will this make me super popular?
Maybe it'll pave my way to becoming a true celebrity...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Kyaa♡ I absolutely gotta win!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos...
Once again, doing what I couldn't...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I must work hard too...
So I can continue being a proper role model for my little sister.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Vivlos...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Vivlos's stellar performance, the momentum shifted our way.
In the end, we pulled off a brilliant comeback victory.
